reviews.t: Plenty of foot spas on Amazon...hard to choose, but I chose wisely.
reviews.x: It took me over 2 weeks to finalize my purchase of a foot spa from Amazon.  There are so many foot spas and tons of reviews for them all, but we're all looking for the best value here.  I finally pulled the trigger and purchased this model.  Our previous foot spa was purchased from Walmart and had a heater, massage rollers (manual rollers) and bubbles, roughly costing around $60.  So my budget for the next spa would be under $100.  Today was my first day using it (1.5 hour usage:)  Pros:  Heater

reviews.t: Truly and amazing product, would HIGHLY recommend to everyone!
reviews.x: I have been looking around for a luxury foot spa massage for almost 2 months: comparing features, functions, price, mobility, everything. I finally decided to order this massager, and I do NOT regret it one bit! This one was a little bit more expensive, but so very worth it. My husband and I are on our feet all day, and it's nice to finally have something to come home and relax with. This is the perfect size to soak in. I love to pour a glass of wine and set the timer for an hour and just close

reviews.t: I highly recommend and would buy again!!! I LOVE THIS LiveFine FOOT SPA MASSAGER!!!
reviews.x: First of all, I don't usually write reviews BUT .... I LOVE this LiveFine Foot Spa Massager.  My ankles were swollen and feet were hurting. It has a deep bucket so the water can cover your ankles and the spin massagers relax your feet. The water heater really works and keeps the water hot!  As an extra bonus it has infrared lights for your heels and a rain shower for the front of your legs to relax you.  All that choices from heat to massager to infrared to rain shower are optional and can used

I wanted to give it a few weeks before I reviewed it but I’ve heard nothing but rave reviews from my mother I’ve never seen rollers like this so I had to get it for her and She absolutely loves it she hasn’t had any issues with her feet or complaints the last few weeks she’s just been getting off work turning this bad boy on and calling in heaven I’ll check back in a few more weeks if it’s still golden I’ll get me one too

I bought this item new and when I opened it the box was already opened (meaning the tap was cut) and the tub was filled with rust, dirt, and human hair. I called to complain and was told I could have a $5 credit for my troubles. Really? There is zero quality control with these products. Very unhappy!

Unfortunately, I purchased based on overall reviews but to my dismay mine purchase was a lemon. I purchased a Christmas present to myself and used it the first time mid January audit worked ok.  You do need a high sitting chair since the depth is rather high. That was small adjustment. My 2nd use was February 1st and none of the functions worked. The only way it worked was to unplug and replug several times and finally it just became a foot soaker because nothing worked. Funny but not funny is t

This foot bath is made very well. Strong motor running the foot rollers. It keeps the water a nice warm temperature for as long as you want it to be. The only thing that would make it perfect would be if it did bubbles also. I knew it didn't have bubbles when I bought it so they didn't lost points because of that.

reviews.t: Impressed with Seller's Readiness to Help
reviews.x: I was not happy with a faulty product that I bought and had to return it. To my surprise, I got a call from the seller who listened to me, resolved the issue with my best interest in mind and left me to believe that he really cared! Thank you for the adequate reaction!

reviews.t: Poor quality checking. Should have listened to the 1 star reviews
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:bf0695b2665c5a9beb38e842f2433f4a]] Looks good, seems good. Literally doesn’t have a massage button. Skipped it in manufacturing. Very disappointed, bought this as a gift for my fiancées birthday got here 2 days before and was missing the massaging button on the control panel! I hope that the seller gets back to me soon, I am willing to adjust this review if they do. But this is awe full for 100 dollars.
I found this foots spa to be very uncomfortable. If you like the feel of putting your feet on large round, hard plastic balls you will love this foot spa. I sent it back.

I was really hoping this would work for me - nope.  I had knee and foot surgery and I have real trouble getting my foot in the bath.  Opening makes you angle your foot and I can't from a sitting position.  You can't stand up in the bath and then sit down.  Bath is so tall that I can't sit on my sofa  The only chair that worked for me was an adjustable desk chair. The rolling balls on the bottom were nice, but I had to keep my foot from pressing down too hard as that would hurt. Bath seems to be

It was working great for me the first of us to use it. We followed the instructions to setting it up. It heated slow but got nice and hot, the motorized rollers felt great and the shower was just fine. After about an hour we were switching to the 2nd person and it shocked her thinking it was too hot. I went to check the water tempt and it electrocuted my finger. We unplugged it immediately and found the bottom had leaked all over our rug. We are returning in fear of an unsafe product.

Great product if it functioned , but stopped working after second use.  I read this in multiple reviews and hoped I would not get a lemon.  The hose would leak water as well, not very quickly, but we decided to still keep it if it still worked.

My son loves his feet smooth. He talks about it often enough that I got this for him.  Pieces came apart on first use and he was disappointed.  I researched a lot first. Guess there is none on here that actually works as advertised.
Water did not heat up very well. Massager balls on the rotating disk in the middle popped off. No air bubbles, no vibration.

After a visit to my podiatrist, he suggested I soak my feet several times a week in Epsom Salts and warm water. I bought a plastic tub, filled it with warm water, only to have it cool off after a few minutes. That's when I started my research to find a foot spa that would keep the water warm. This LiveFine Foot Spa Massager does, for sure. It also has turning rollers to massage your feet, and these rollers are removable, if desired. I use the Foot Spa half the time without the rollers and then p

reviews.t: Too hot and hard on feet
reviews.x: This is my first ever footspa and while i liked the deep tub and heating (2 stars), this particular spa would not stop heating up. When i set it to 99 (for cold feet) it kept heating past 100 and getting too hot for me. Secondly, the massagers were too hard for my feet and actually had to work to keep the feet on top of the massagers instead of relaxing...as feet would just spin off the rollers. The shower feature was so light, that in contrast to the hard agressive rollers, they were unnoticeab

reviews.t: Could be great with some adjustments
reviews.x: I loved it at first, my clients were excited with all the great features. However,  1). It's annoying getting your feet in (in my case, a client's), the space is narrow so you have to bend your foot down or twist to the side (would not recommend to anyone with feet larger than a size 7.)   2) after maybe a month the buttons stopped working, I would have to pull out the plug to turn it off. And it was stuck on a high temperature so that made it worse!

I want to be able to set the heat to a comfortable number, like 92, or 98. But it just continues to get hotter and hotter. It goes up to 118 degrees. That is just too hot for me. I can't turn it off when it hits the temp that I like because then I can't use the massaging option. I have searched the website trying to see if I am doing something wrong. I have not found any information on this. I LOVE the idea and the Spa...just not the high temp.

First I received was dead on arrival. Was sent a replacement immediately. It’s nice. Stays super hot. Massage feature not used that much. Not for my liking. Overall nice foot spa minus the immediate replacement
I loved this product the first three times I used it, but after that the board stopped working and I cannot adjust the temperature or turn off/on any of the features.  Complete junk
This product is amazing, very relaxing. You can do your Pedi at home and not rush. The whole family will enjoy. It's very useful and complete. Loved I!
Love this product. Works well after a long day of work and need to soak my feet. I'd recommend this product for anyone and not bad priced.
i bought this as a gift for my wife's birthday. ..well, she loves it and we have a standing date night for her sweet feet!!! LOL
I like the product, it is relaxing. I wish the leg shower was more powerful and that there were bubbles.

claims.text: Several reviewers report the unit breaking or falling apart after only a few uses, including stopped function, leaking hose, and pieces coming apart.
Some buyers received defective or used units, citing missing parts, rust/dirt/hair in the tub, and poor quality control.
Many reviewers praise the product's performance, saying the heater keeps water hot and the rollers/massagers relax their feet.
Some users find the design uncomfortable or hard to use, citing hard plastic balls and a tall, awkward opening.
A few reviewers highlight strong seller support, with one noting the seller resolved a faulty product issue personally.
